name: RZ Gem
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 5.53 days; its mean radius is 39.2 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 39.2 +/- 3.8 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 145, Name='RZ Gem', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5750 +/- 412 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3423693395726613504 (quality E), from 1953GCRV..C......0W; Gaia DR3 measures none

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RZ Gem: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1990.3 +/- 193.9 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.563 +/- 0.025 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 39 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 5.5 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 39.2 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,990 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, RZ Gem: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.
